methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $100M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Nyobolt is a Series B climate and energy company founded by Sai Shivareddy and Clare Grey, having raised over $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 private firms and 1 public comparable (LNZA), including same-stage and adjacent-stage companies such as KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $100M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier typical of the sector, implies a valuation of $190M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—KoBold Metals ($3.0B, Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B, Series C), and Amogy ($700M, Series C)—yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range of $700M to $3.0B. The dispersion in peer valuations reflects variance in technology maturity and capital intensity within frontier energy.

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $162M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $595M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around market adoption timelines and the early-stage nature of frontier energy technologies. Key sensitivities include commercialization progress relative to peers and capital requirements through profitability.
